output: Scientific Hypothesis: The peak in the use or production of Axes & Celts occurred during the 32nd century BCE, as indicated by the maximum interpolated Z values in the `AxesCelts_inter` column of the `time_series_data.csv` dataset. This hypothesis is based on the relationship between the Z values for Axes & Celts and the corresponding Common Era (CE) values, which are negative (BCE). The statistical significance of this peak is supported by the consistent maximum value of 2.6 in the `AxesCelts_inter` column, corresponding to the CE value of -3200.
